title: Concept: SHA-1 selected by name (csharp) — review required
description: In csharp, naming SHA-1 (SHA1.Creates*(s*)) requests a deprecated digest. Name-selected digests hide inside factory calls, so reviewers must check the string. The csharp-specific remedy is selecting SHA256.Create().
applicability: csharp codebases selecting digests by name; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Forged digests where security is assumed; LOW default severity, raised when the digest guards trust.
